items.title: Submit certified bachelor's degree certificate and transcript with translations
items.quote: Please send us officially certified copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and your transcript of records, together with certified German or English translations, so that they reach us by 24 August 2027.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar date by which the certified documents must physically arrive at the university: 24 August 2027. This is a private deadline set directly by the sender, not a period to be counted from delivery, so no §§ 187/188 BGB calculation is needed. 24 August 2027 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NW, so the date stands as written (no weekend/holiday shift applies to a date given as a calendar date).
